tools.name: generate_3d_asset
tools.description:
Start generating a 3D model from a reference image (runs in background).

Uses the local TRELLIS generator. Returns IMMEDIATELY with a job handle - the generation itself takes ~60s at resolution 512 or ~5 minutes at 1024.

Workflow:
  1. generate_3d_asset (this tool) - starts the job
  2. check_asset_job - call repeatedly until it reports DONE
  3. import_generated_asset - brings the result into /Game at real size

Rules:
  - asset_name must be NEW - regeneration under an existing name is refused
  - Only one generation runs at a time (the GPU is shared)
  - Never claim the asset exists until check_asset_job reports DONE

image_path.description: Absolute path to the reference image on disk, e.g. C:/Refs/drone_iso.png

asset_name.description: New unique name, letters/digits/underscores only, e.g. cargo_drone_v2

tools.name: check_asset_job
tools.description:
Check whether a 3D asset generation job has finished.

Returns immediately with one of:
  - DONE: the GLB path, size and sha256, ready for import_generated_asset
  - STILL RUNNING: elapsed time so far; call check_asset_job again to keep waiting
  - FAILED: the error log tail - report this honestly, do not retry blindly

Generation takes about 60s at resolution 512, so expect to call this several times before it reports DONE. That is normal and correct.

asset_name.description: The asset_name that was passed to generate_3d_asset

tools.name: import_generated_asset
tools.description:
Import a generated 3D asset into /Game at its real-world size, verified.

Only works after check_asset_job reports DONE for that asset_name. Runs the Blender scale-bake (generated models are unit-scale and MUST be scaled), imports as a single StaticMesh with Nanite, measures the result against target_size_cm (3% tolerance) and writes an audit receipt.

On success the result names the created asset path and its measured size. A size-verification failure means the asset exists but must not be used - report it.

asset_name.description: The asset_name of a generation that check_asset_job reported DONE

target_size_cm.description: Real-world size in cm on the defining axis, e.g. 220 for a 2.2m drone

defining_axis.description: Which axis target_size_cm refers to: x, y, z or longest (default)
